Name: Ariel
Action: Can assist with healing and protecting wildlife and environmental protection particularly water sources.

Name: Azrael
Action: Gives support and assistance at the time of physical death and aids transition to the other side. Provides healing energy and comfort to family and friends during the grieving process.

Name: Chamuel
Action: Helps you to build strong loving relationships and find a meaningful career and life purpose.

Name: Christiel
Action: Helps with inner peace and knowledge of the higher self. She will assist you to raise your vibrational energy to discover a higher level of spiritual understanding.

Name: Gabriel
Action: She is known as the messenger angel, and helps with the arts and communication. She assists with inspiration and motivation to take action and express your talent.

Name: Haniel
Action: Helps you to enjoy beauty, harmony and grace. Call on her to assist with spiritual healing work and to develop intuition and psychic abilities.

Name: Jeremiel
Action: He helps newly crossed over souls review their lives. He encourages and assists with life reviews during this lifetime to learn from your experiences and make positive changes.

Name: Jophiel
Action: She helps you to see and appreciate the beauty inside and around you. She assists you to create, manifest and attract beauty into all areas of your life.

Name: Metatron
Action: He is the record keeper for the Akashic Records. He has a strong energetic energy and will assist you with focus, motivation management and goals.

Name: Michael
Action: His energy is strong and protective; he assists with your life purpose and to alleviate fears. Call on him for spiritual protection and to clear negative energy.

Name: Muriel
Action: She helps you to find balance and harmony of your emotions and to distinguish between your emotions and other peoples. Call on her to assist with trusting your intuition.

Name: Raguel
Action: He is the angel of justice, fairness and harmony. He assists in challenging situations to restore balance and peace.

Name: Raphael
Action: He is a powerful healer of body, mind and soul for humans and animals. His energy is loving and kind and he will assist the healer and the healing when asked.

Name: Raziel
Action: He is intelligent and wise, call on him when you need understanding and guidance. He will assist with manifestation, spiritual information and abilities.

Name: Sachiel
Action: He is a guardian of the spiritual universal laws and helps with success and prosperity. He will assist you to find harmony and align with your purpose.

Name: Sandalphon
Action: He is a connection between Heaven and Earth and delivers prayers. Ask for his assistance to ensure your messages will be heard and responded to.

Name: Uriel
Action: He is a wise mentor helping with life lessons and to evolve and expand. Call upon him for information, solutions and insight to make informed decisions.

Name: Zadkiel
Action: He helps you to see the divine light in yourself and others. Call on him to assist with forgiveness, love and compassion for self and others
